summary: Define strict collection-scoped membership cursor identity and restart errors without activating the new paging contract

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rebuild is required.

schema.detail: No durable schema changes. The distinct versioned cursor contains local host, projection, epoch, collection state and keyset fields, with no wall-clock expiry.

rules.detail: Existing authorization remains required before cursor validation; a cursor grants no access.

compatibility.detail: Existing endpoints and stream frames are unchanged and no capability is advertised. Collection paging error codes preserve the existing envelope and explicitly refuse generic same-cursor retries.

recovery.detail: Changed collection or incomparable scope requires a fresh attempt. Codec validation retains no transaction, page buffer or lease.
